fc4.displacement.ref: heuristic: random-displacement amplitude commonly used with symfc / pypolymlp fits; large enough for the quartic term to show in the forces

fc4.fc3_cutoff.ref: heuristic: symfc cutoff for FC3; validate by cutoff convergence on a top candidate

fc4.fc4_cutoff.ref: heuristic: symfc cutoff for FC4 (nearest neighbours in light-element solids)

fc4.snapshot_factor.ref: heuristic: snapshots x 3N forces >= factor x number of symfc basis functions

fc4.max_fc4_gb.ref: execution only (does not change results); refuse when the dense compact FC4 would exceed it

fc4.temperature.ref: heuristic (ladder rung, plan §9.3): a ranking/escalation signal, validated against L1/L4

fc4.q_mesh.ref: None: the L1 q-mesh; FourPhonon 4ph scattering cost grows steeply with it

fc4.num_sample_4ph.ref: FourPhonon manual / Example-Si-sampling: 4ph phase space and RTA rates from this many sampled processes per mode (Guo et al., npj Comput. Mater. 2023); <= 0 = exact, which is impractical: the exact Example-Si (16^3) did not finish in 12 h on 128 cores (job 960801)

fc4.iterative.ref: RTA for both 3ph and 3+4ph, so the ratio compares like with like

fc4.fourphonon_cmd.ref: execution only (does not change results); e.g. 'srun /path/ShengBTE' (FourPhonon build); default $MGA_FOURPHONON; unset = write inputs only

fc4.chunk_size.ref: execution only (does not change results); structures per job (an L3 structure can take hours)

resources.cpus_per_task.reason: FourPhonon runs inside the L3 GPU job for S0 (3 structures): 32 OpenMP threads; Example-Si-sampling took 1608 s on 32 cores (job 963770)

resources.nodelist.ref: execution only (does not change results); one node, e.g. 'a-a100-o-1' (A100-SXM4-80GB): the GPU partitions mix 40 and 80 GB cards and 512-atom supercells do not fit 48 GB (configs/models.yaml)

resources.exclude_nodes.ref: execution only (does not change results); comma-separated node names
